preconditions.description: Attacker must have owner role to access setTaxFeePercent, setLiquidityFeePercent, or setMaxTxPercent functions

exploit_hint: As contract owner, call setTaxFeePercent(), setLiquidityFeePercent(), or setMaxTxPercent() to modify critical tokenomics parameters. These functions change state variables (_taxFee, _liquidityFee, _maxTxAmount) without emitting any events, making it impossible for users and monitoring systems to track these critical parameter changes on-chain. This lack of transparency can be abused by a malicious owner to silently change fees or transaction limits without user awareness.
